DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic)

The bilirubin level of 16.1 mg/dL is elevated but the normal direct bilirubin (0.7 mg/dL) and history of a healthy 2-week-old infant strongly suggest benign breastfeeding jaundice rather than pathologic causes like hemolysis or sepsis. Continue frequent breastfeeding and monitor for feeding difficulties or signs of dehydration.
